svg.title: 推进路径

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: 从原型到生产的推进路径

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: 每一阶段需要补齐的能力，以及该阶段可以验证的东西

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: 阶段一 原型（已完成）

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: 已部署可访问

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: 数据：合成技师与客户；真实问题库 CSV

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: 系统：单进程 + SQLite；真实模型、路网与地理编码

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: 人工：全部审批与人工队列已实现

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: 可验证：调度规则、权限边界、Agent 行为与可追溯性

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: 阶段二 试点（1 家企业 · 4–8 周）

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: 需要企业配合

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: 数据：导入真实问题库、技师名册与历史工单

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: 系统：接入真实通知通道；自建路网服务

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: 人工：保留全部审批点，按周复盘误判

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: 可验证：KPI 基线与改善幅度、人工介入比例

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: 阶段三 生产

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: 规模化前提

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: 数据：多企业隔离；问题库版本管理

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: 系统：多租户、PostgreSQL、多进程、真实支付与定位

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: 人工：分角色权限与完整审计

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: 可验证：单位成本、留存与跨部门扩展

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: 本系统当前处于阶段一并已线上运行（见技术设计文档第 7 章）。阶段二不需要重写系统：问题库、技师名册与业务规则都是配置，接入真实通道是替换 provider 实现。

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: 阶段二与阶段三的时间与范围为规划假设，尚未实施
